configurePresets.name: _machine
configurePresets.description: Where the installed dependencies live. Edit this ONE preset on another machine; the tiers below inherit it. Kokkos is required at every tier and is machine-optimised, which is why nothing is fetched by default.

configurePresets.name: tier0
configurePresets.description: The always-buildable configuration. Serial and threaded kernels, the supermesh remap, every unit test.

configurePresets.name: tier0-release
configurePresets.description: FUSE_ASSERT is verified live under NDEBUG on this leg; it is not a decoration.

configurePresets.name: tier0-no-exceptions
configurePresets.description: Every refusal aborts instead of unwinding. Run tests with -LE throws.

configurePresets.name: tier0-release-fast
configurePresets.description: KNOWN_ISSUES.md D30: FUSE_FP_REPRODUCIBLE=OFF leaves the compiler's default floating-point contraction in place (fused multiply-add, one rounding instead of two). Faster at a measured per-operation cost (docs/dev/testing.md); the three tests D30 names then check a derived forward-error bound instead of bit-identity with Debug. tier0-release itself stays FUSE_FP_REPRODUCIBLE=ON (the option's own default), so a plain tier0-release build reproduces Debug's bits exactly.

configurePresets.name: tier1
configurePresets.description: Adds the MPI transport, rank graph, agreement points and the parallel test legs (mpiexec at 2/3/4/5 ranks).

configurePresets.name: tier2
configurePresets.description: Adds the MOAB mesh backend and its 38-case suite. Requires tier 1: the ladder refuses MOAB without MPI. TempestRemap is picked up automatically when the MOAB found was built with it.

configurePresets.name: tier3
configurePresets.description: Adds the implicit/monolithic solver path (S7). Configures today; the solver plugin is not yet written.

configurePresets.name: all
configurePresets.displayName: All features - MPI, MOAB with TempestRemap, PETSc
configurePresets.description: Every tier in one build dir (build-all). PETSc AND MOAB come from /opt/petsc/download-moab (PETSc 3.25 with MOAB 5.6.0, HDF5; gcc 16.2.0) -- the user's designated prefix since 2026-10-11; the other PETSc and MOAB installs on this machine are older. That MOAB has no TempestRemap, so the high-order spherical remap method refuses at run time; measured 2026-10-11 that the registered row set is identical (299) to the /opt/moab-tempest configuration. Its config does not export its dependencies' headers, so FuseDependencies.cmake recovers <PKG>_DIR/include per MOAB_USE_<PKG>.

testPresets.name: tier0-quick
testPresets.description: Everything except the rows labelled `slow` (cmake/FuseSlowTests.cmake), two at a time: the routine pre-commit run. Prefix with `nice -n 19` on a laptop.

testPresets.name: all-quick
testPresets.description: As tier0-quick, for the all-tiers build.
